root_cause: Several workflows were triggered for every or overly broad pull-request change even though their jobs were inapplicable or diagnostic-only. Repository Writer Candidate Shadow emitted skipped runs on ordinary PRs despite already having an exact workflow_dispatch route; Pagina/SEO diagnose performed a full build and browser/SEO scan on PRs despite being diagnostic and currently surfacing unrelated baseline debt; cross-browser assurance treated the release-risk classifier config as a website runtime artifact.
prevention: Use explicit workflow_dispatch for immutable writer shadow verification, keep Pagina/SEO diagnose manual-only, and exclude site/website-release-risk.json from cross-browser PR path matching while retaining daily scheduled and real website-change assurance.
